title: China's Best Green Tea Is Fried by Bare Hands at 200°C | China Travel Expert
description:
China's most famous green tea, West Lake Longjing (Dragon Well), is still finished by hand — pressed and shaped directly in an iron wok heated to around 200°C, with no gloves and no tools. Over the years, the masters' palms scar, heal and scar again.

The craft uses ten named hand movements — shaking, pressing, grinding and more — and the maker switches between them by feel as the leaf dries. In 2022 the traditional green-tea technique of West Lake Longjing was inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list.

🧭 Expert Tip: For the good stuff, ask for "pre-Qingming" (明前) Longjing — leaves picked before the Qingming festival around April 5. It's the most prized, most tender harvest of the year.

中国最好的绿茶,是一双手在200°C的锅里炒出来的。
